strategyTaxonomy.operatorSummary: Keeps starter-only selection and trims one name so the basket is slightly more concentrated.

reasonCodes.label: Starts from the pinned US Tech Leaders basket membership.
Selects names from the starter basket only.
Applies a 0% score boost to starter-basket names inside broader selection.
Ranks names by baseline signal score.
Weights names with the signal score proportional curve.
Raises ranking scores to the 1x power before weights are normalized.
Keeps 4% in the AUSD yield buffer.
Only rebalances after 275 bps of drift.

summaries.construction: 96% stays in xStocks across 6 names. 4% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 17%, MSFTx 16.87%, AAPLx 16.16%.
summaries.benchmark: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.45% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.29%.
summaries.rebalance: Rebalance only when drift clears 275 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.14% annualized turnover, 12.01 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 96% turnover and 43.6 bps total costs with 4% parked in AUSD.
summaries.realityCheck: Authoritative scoring now uses 275 bps drift bands and implies 3.14% annualized turnover across 1 rebalance events; legacy static proxy remains available for comparison.
summaries.operator: Starter Breadth Trim keeps 96% in xStocks across 6 starter basket only names anchored to US Tech Leaders, with 4% in AUSD. Top sleeves: NVDAx 17%, MSFTx 16.87%, AAPLx 16.16%. Change from slot baseline: Breadth: 7 names -> 6 names. After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.45% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.29%.

strategyFamily.operatorSummary: Keeps starter-only selection and trims one name so the basket is slightly more concentrated.

tuningSummary.incumbentInterpretation: Starter Breadth Trim. 6-name starter basket only basket with 4% in AUSD. NVDAx is the largest sleeve at 17%. Under the authoritative path-dependent rebalance scorer, after costs it outperformed basket.sp500_core_v1 by 10.29% in the frozen window.

currentKnobs.label: Candidate family
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps starter-only selection and trims one name so the basket is slightly more concentrated.

currentKnobs.label: Starter basket
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes basket membership before weights are assigned.

currentKnobs.label: Selection universe
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Widens the eligible pool beyond the starter basket without changing slot identity.

currentKnobs.label: Holdings breadth
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how many names survive ranking into the target basket.

currentKnobs.label: Starter anchor bias
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the slot anchored to its starter basket even when broader selection is enabled.

currentKnobs.label: Ranking signal
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes which names rise or fall inside the current basket.

currentKnobs.label: Weighting curve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how aggressively higher-ranked names dominate the basket.

currentKnobs.label: Signal power
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Makes the weighting curve flatter or more conviction-heavy without changing the underlying signal.

currentKnobs.label: Cash sleeve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how much capital stays in AUSD instead of xStocks exposure.

currentKnobs.label: Single-name cap
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Limits the maximum weight of one name.

currentKnobs.label: Rebalance trigger
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Skips smaller drifts to reduce churn.

watchpoints: NVDAx is the largest sleeve at 17% against a 17% single-name cap.
Authoritative rebalance simulation implies 3.14% turnover and 12.01 bps of annualized costs across 1 rebalance events.
Authoritative turnover is 3.14% with 12.01 bps of total costs.
Legacy static proxy would have printed 96% turnover and 43.6 bps of total costs.
6 names are selected from the starter basket only.
Benchmark edge after costs is 10.29% versus basket.sp500_core_v1.
